display.purpose: The hero name only. 6rem at 768px and up, with a 3px 3px Deep Water Blue offset.

headline.purpose: Section headings. 4.5rem at 1024px and up, with a 3px 3px offset and a 1px blue rule below.

title.purpose: Project titles in Tide Emerald, with a 1px 1px offset.

title-sm.purpose: Job titles in the experience cards.

tagline.purpose: The role line under the hero name. 1.5rem at 768px and up.

body.purpose: Centered project descriptions at 80% opacity. 1.125rem at 1024px and up.

label.purpose: Uppercase dates, location, and job type in the experience cards.

shadows.name: offset-pill
shadows.purpose: Contact pills. The first pill uses -3px 3px and the last pill uses 3px 3px, so the offsets fan out from the center.

shadows.name: legacy-card
shadows.purpose: Legacy. Experience and education cards. Do not use in new work.

shadows.name: legacy-project-halo
shadows.purpose: Legacy. Project cards; rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) in the dark theme. Do not use in new work.

motion.name: theme-change

motion.name: wave-drift
motion.purpose: Path morph of the wave divider layers.

motion.name: pill-expand

motion.name: toolbar-hover

components.name: Contact Pill
components.description: Round emerald link with an icon and a Barlow label, on a hard blue offset. Shown in a centered row in the hero and the contact section.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; } .ds-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary-700, #007a55); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 3px #1d4ed8; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-pill:first-of-type { box-shadow: -3px 3px #1d4ed8; } .ds-pill:last-of-type { box-shadow: 3px 3px #1d4ed8; } .ds-pill:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600, #009966); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-400, #00d492); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill-icon { width: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-pill-label { padding-right: 12px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.75rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: Square emerald icon button in the top-right toolbar, for the theme toggle and the language switch.
components.css: .ds-toolbar-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-primary-500, #00bc7d); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-toolbar-btn { background: var(--color-primary-700, #007a55); } .ds-toolbar-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-toolbar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-400, #00d492); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Josefin Sans heading in emerald on a hard blue offset, with a 1px blue rule under the full width of the text.
components.css: .ds-heading { position: relative; width: min-content; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 8px 8px; white-space: nowrap; text-align: center; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 3.4rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-primary-500, #00bc7d); text-shadow: 3px 3px #1e40af; } .ds-heading::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--color-secondary-800, #193cb8); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-heading { color: var(--color-primary-400, #00d492); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-heading::after { background: var(--color-secondary-600, #155dfc); }

components.css: .ds-exp-card { max-width: 640px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-page-foreground, #0f172b); } .ds-exp-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-exp-date { color: var(--color-primary-700, #007a55); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-exp-date { color: var(--color-primary-300, #5ee9b5); } .ds-exp-dim { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-exp-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-exp-company { margin: 2px 0 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-exp-body { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-exp-tags { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-project { max-width: 560px; padding-bottom: 12px; text-align: center; color: var(--color-page-foreground, #0f172b); } .ds-project-image { height: 160px; margin: 20px 20px 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-page-foreground, #0f172b) 8%, transparent); } .ds-project-title { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 2.5rem; color: var(--color-primary-500, #00bc7d); text-shadow: 1px 1px #1d4ed8; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-project-title { color: var(--color-primary-400, #00d492); } .ds-project-body { margin: 16px 20px 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.025em; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-project-meta { margin: 20px 20px 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-project-year { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-project-year svg { vertical-align: -0.125em; }

components.name: Experience Timeline
components.description: Vertical emerald spine at 40% opacity with a triangle arrowhead on top, and a 24px emerald dot for each entry.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; max-width: 480px; padding-top: 32px; } .ds-timeline-arrow { position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: var(--color-primary-500, #00bc7d); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-timeline-spine { position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 16px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary-500, #00bc7d) 40%, transparent); } .ds-timeline-entry { position: relative; padding-left: 48px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-timeline-dot { position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 12px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary-400, #00d492); } .ds-timeline-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-page-foreground, #0f172b); font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Wave Divider
components.description: Two-layer emerald gradient wave band that splits the page into section groups. In the site, two bands stack and the paths morph in a 40s linear loop.
components.css: .ds-wave { display: block; width: 100%; height: 10rem; transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-wave-start { stop-color: var(--hr-start, #00d084); } .ds-wave-end { stop-color: var(--hr-end, #7bdcb5); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a calm sea of slate. Bright emerald type floats on it, and a hard blue undertow sits below each important word and button. Animated waves divide the page into three tides: projects, history, and contact. Each section has a lot of open space, and every block sits on one center axis.

The mood is calm and clean. Color stays in a small set of roles: emerald for type and action, blue for the undertow, slate for everything else. Secondary text uses opacity steps of the foreground color, not new grays. Motion is slow and ambient, or it answers a direct action. Content does not animate into view.

Light and dark themes have equal rank. The system preference selects the theme, and a toolbar toggle changes it. Each color role has one value for each theme.
keyCharacteristics: Josefin Sans display type in emerald, on a hard blue offset with zero blur.
One center axis for all text, headings, cards, and tags.
Three animated emerald wave dividers: one under the hero, and one between each pair of section groups.
Depth comes from hard offsets. Soft blurred shadows are legacy.
Two corner radii only: 12px and full.
Timelines with emerald spines, dots, and triangle arrowheads.

rules.name: The Undertow Rule
rules.body: Blue never leads. It sits under emerald as an offset, under a heading as a 1px rule, or as the one job bar on the education timeline.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the `page`, `page-foreground`, and `card` tokens for neutrals. They change value with the theme, so a new surface needs no `dark:` override.

rules.name: The Josefin Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The Josefin Sans file stops at weight 600. `font-bold` and `font-black` render as 600, so use `font-semibold` for new Josefin text.

rules.name: The Center Axis Rule
rules.body: Center new content on the page axis. Do not add left-aligned columns or sidebars.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Depth has zero blur. If a shape must lift, give it a solid blue offset of 1px to 3px.

dos: Do set new display and heading text in Josefin Sans 600, in Tide Emerald (Tide Emerald Bright in the dark theme), on a hard Deep Water Blue offset.
Do give depth with a solid blue offset of 1px to 3px and zero blur (The Hard Offset Rule).
Do center new content on the page axis (The Center Axis Rule).
Do use the `page`, `page-foreground`, and `card` tokens, and step secondary text down to 80%, 70%, or 60% opacity.
Do give every new color role a value for the light theme and for the dark theme.
Do keep theme changes to a 300ms color transition.
Do put ambient motion behind `motion-safe`, as the contact pills do.
donts: Don't add entrance fade-ins or slide-ins on page load. Content shows at once.
Don't blur project images or their previews. Show them sharp and centered.
Don't add new soft, blurred drop shadows. The existing card shadows are legacy.
Don't use blue as a text color or a large fill (The Undertow Rule).
Don't use `font-bold` or `font-black` on Josefin Sans (The Josefin Ceiling Rule).
Don't use the `font-lato` utility. No Lato font loads, so the class has no effect.
Don't add a third corner radius. Use 12px or full rounding.
